chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, who said:

Al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) regarding Ibn Asbaat, saying: 'What is your view for him?' Ibn Asbaat was present with all of us. 'If he were to travel by land or sea to Egypt, inform him of the best route by land.' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'The land. And go to the Masjid at a time other than that of the obligatory prayer. So pray two Rak'at, and seek Allah's choice (Istikhara) one hundred times. Then see what occurs in your heart, and act upon it.' And he (peace be upon him) said to him: 'The land is more beloved to me for him.' He said: 'And to me.'
ai.seo_question: How to perform the prayer of Istikhara for making a decision according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the practical application of Istikhara by Imam al-Rida (AS) in a specific context of travel, emphasizing the combination of ritual prayer and spiritual intuition. The instruction to repeat the supplication one hundred times underscores the depth of contemplation required, while the Imam’s confirmation that 'the land is more preferable to me' illustrates how the resulting heart inclination aligns with divine wisdom. This hadith serves as a foundational text in Shia jurisprudence for understanding Istikhara not merely as a ritual, but as a means of clarifying the heart's disposition toward a chosen path.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal who said,

‘Al-Hassan Bin Al-Jahm asked Abu Al-Hassanasws for Ibn Asbaat, so he said, ‘What is yourasws view for him’, and Ibn Asbaat was present with all of us, ‘if he were to ride the land or (sail) the sea to Egypt, so inform him with the best road by land’. So heasws said: ‘The land, and go over to the Masjid (of Rasool-Allahsaww) in other than a time for the Obligatory Salāt. So you should pray two Rak’at of Salāt and leave the choice to Allahazwj, one hundred times, then look at which thing occurs in your heart, so act upon it’. And heasws said to him: ‘And the superiority of the land is more beloved to measws, for him’. He said, ‘And to me’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal who has said the following:

“Al-Hassan ibn Jahm asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, for ibn Asbat; ibn Asbat and we all were present. ‘Should he travel by land or by sea to Egypt? Please tell him about the best road by land.’ The Imam said, ‘By land, but go to the Masjid in a time other than that for obligatory Salah (prayer). Perform two Rak‘at Salah (prayer) and ask Allah, one hundred times, to choose for you the best. Then see what comes in your mind, then act accordingly.’ Al-Hassan then said, ‘By land is what I like for him.’ The Imam said, ‘I also like for him by land.’”
